goal.title: Build a press kit page with logos, screenshots, boilerplate and a fact sheet, by Fri 20 Nov
goal.description: Journalists, podcast hosts and partners need one place to grab accurate facts about Zedu without emailing the team. Work under this goal: list what a press page must hold (short and long company description, one-page fact sheet with only team-confirmed numbers, founder and team names the team approves, logos in light and dark, 6 real product screenshots, contact email); draft all the written parts; and write the shot list and file naming for the logos and screenshots. A person supplies the final logo files and screenshots, and confirms every number. Nothing is invented. Done when the page copy, fact sheet and asset list are approved and a person has published the page.
